title: Excellent app
body: Simple but very effective app for general habit control and activity tracking. Highly recommend
author: Morgz75

title: Simple and achieves its purpose
body: Great app! Very simple but does exactly what it needs to do. The free version has all the features but limits the amount of habits you can track at once so try it out and if it works for you, you can upgrade as I did 😊
author: Freeman412
